name: Maia
source:
A vagabond mercenary. Extremely experienced in combat. She’s able to live on her own without relying on others because of the tough, mercenary life she’s lived. The mercenaries under the [url=/c58843]protagonist's[/url] command are fond of her (in many ways) for her easygoing persona.

A generous and helpful person who’s a bit like an older sibling, but she’s particularly cold towards guys who try to get in her pants.

A rich brat she was acting as a bodyguard for once tried to get with her, but she shot him down, and has been resented by this person ever since.

When she was young and just became a mercenary she once fought together with the protagonist. She believed he was a reliable man and liked him a bit.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1058]MangaGamer[/url]]
